sentences.en: But it's always going to create a bit of mistrust between President Biden and Zelensky or people

sentences.en: in the next tiers down because they know that the United States is listening in on them just as actively as it's listening in on the Russians.

sentences.zh: 对谁进行间谍活动？

sentences.en: Well, we also learned that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们还了解到，美国

sentences.en: is deeply into the South Korean National Security Council and deeply inside Israel's Mossad, the spying agency.
sentences.zh: 深入渗透了韩国国家安全委员会，并深度介入了以色列的间谍机构摩萨德。

sentences.en: And those countries are both sort of fence-sitters.

sentences.en: They've publicly avoided committing to providing much help to the Ukrainians, even if they've done some help on the side.
sentences.zh: 他们公开避免承诺向乌克兰提供太多实质帮助，尽管他们在私底下提供了一些协助。

sentences.en: And so what's particularly important and potentially damaging here is the documents reveal these
sentences.zh: 因此，特别重要且可能具有破坏性的是，文件揭示了这些

sentences.en: internal conversations that are happening among the top leaders in these countries about the war or about the United States.
sentences.zh: 这些国家最高领导人之间就战争或美国展开的内部对话。

sentences.en: So what do the documents say about South Korea and Israel?
sentences.zh: 那么文件对韩国和以色列是怎么说的？

sentences.en: What do the documents tell us?
sentences.zh: 文件告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: Well, let's start with South Korea, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 好吧，萨布丽娜，我们先从韩国开始。

sentences.en: I was just there a couple of weeks ago doing some reporting.
sentences.zh: 我几周前刚去那里做过报道。

sentences.en: And when I met senior South Korean officials and I said, look, you're one of the largest producers in the world of a kind of ammunition the Ukrainians need.
sentences.zh: 当我见到韩国高级官员时我说，听着，你们是乌克兰所需的那类弹药的全球最大生产国之一。

sentences.en: They're called 155 millimeter artillery rounds.
sentences.zh: 它们被称为155毫米火炮炮弹。

sentences.en: Are you providing them to the Ukrainians?
sentences.zh: 你们在向乌克兰提供这些吗？

sentences.en: And they would hedge and haw and really wouldn't answer the question and say, well, it's very difficult for us.
sentences.zh: 他们就会支支吾吾、顾左右而言他，根本不正面回答问题，并说，嗯，这对我们来说非常困难。

sentences.en: We have policies about providing weapons into a war zone.
sentences.zh: 我们有关于向战区提供武器的政策。

sentences.en: And of course, they really don't want to anger the Russians.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们确实不想惹恼俄罗斯。

sentences.en: And so then we get these documents, which are dated before my visit to South Korea.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就拿到了这些文件，其日期在我访问韩国之前。

sentences.en: And what do we discover?
sentences.zh: 我们发现了什么？

sentences.en: That, yes, there's a big fight going on within their National Security Council, that they're afraid that President Biden is going to call President Yoon of South Korea and demand
sentences.zh: 是的，他们的国家安全委员会内部正发生激烈的争论，他们担心拜登总统会打电话给韩国总统尹锡悦，并要求

sentences.en: that he provide more ammunition.
sentences.zh: 他提供更多弹药。

sentences.en: And this would put him on the spot.
sentences.zh: 这会把他推到风口浪尖上。

sentences.en: It's delicate because Yoon himself is coming to Washington in just a few weeks for a big state visit, the first state visit of an Asian leader to the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 情况很微妙，因为尹锡悦本人再过几周就要来华盛顿进行一次大型国事访问，这是拜登政府接待的第一位亚洲领导人的国事访问。

sentences.en: So this was all embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都很尴尬。

sentences.en: And then you turn the page.
sentences.zh: 接着你翻过页。

sentences.en: And what do you discover?
sentences.zh: 你发现了什么？

sentences.en: There is one page that has got basically shipping details of the 155 millimeter rounds, 330,000 of them.
sentences.zh: 有一页基本上是155毫米炮弹的运输明细，数量达33万枚。

sentences.en: And when they would be sea lifted from South Korea, when they would likely get to Ukraine and in great bureaucratic fashion, how much it was going to cost to send them from one
sentences.zh: 以及它们何时从韩国海运、大概什么时候能运到乌克兰，并且极具官僚作风地标明了将其从一地

sentences.en: to the other.
sentences.zh: 运到另一地将花费多少钱。

sentences.en: So what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那这意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, it doesn't spell out if that shipment actually went, Sabrina, but it could mean that the South Koreans were quietly providing help or thinking about it and just didn't want
sentences.zh: 嗯，它并没有明确说明这批货物是否真的运出了，萨布丽娜，但这可能意味着韩国人一直在悄悄提供帮助，或者正在考虑这么做，只是不想

sentences.en: it to be publicized.
sentences.zh: 让它公之于众。

sentences.en: And now here it is out on Twitter and Discord for the whole world to see.
sentences.zh: 而现在它却出现在推特和Discord上，让全世界都看到了。

sentences.en: And David, what about Israel?
sentences.zh: 大卫，那以色列呢？

sentences.en: They've been similar to South Korea.
sentences.zh: 他们的情况和韩国类似。

sentences.en: They make a big case that they don't get involved in active wars.
sentences.zh: 他们极力标榜自己不卷入热战。

sentences.en: But of course, you know, they're very concerned about their own sovereignty and territory that they believe is their own.
sentences.zh: 但当然，你知道的，他们非常关心自己的主权以及他们认为是自己的领土。

sentences.en: But one of the documents lays out an American set of scenarios of events that could happen, like the Iranians taking in aircraft from Russia as part of the Iran-Russia.
sentences.zh: 但其中一份文件列出了一套美国假设可能发生的事件情景，比如伊朗从俄罗斯接收飞机，作为伊俄

sentences.en: deals that are going on these days that might actually force the Israelis to get off the fence and provide more aid to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 当前正在进行的交易的一部分，这实际上可能会迫使以色列放弃骑墙观望，向乌克兰提供更多援助。

sentences.en: And it specified what Israeli weapon systems they want.
sentences.zh: 并且它具体指出了他们想要的以色列武器系统。

sentences.en: So here we see the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以在这里我们看到美国

sentences.en: speculating about what conditions might be exploited to draw the Israelis into arming the Ukrainians and getting them off the fence.
sentences.zh: 在推测可以利用什么条件来诱使以色列武装乌克兰并让他们放弃中立。

sentences.en: So in both of these cases, David, both South Korea and Israel, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以在审视这两个国家时，大卫，无论是韩国还是以色列，美国

sentences.en: is trying to kind of, you know, use a spyglass to see what's coming in terms of helping the Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 都在试图，你知道的，用望远镜来观察在援助乌克兰方面接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the reason that these are embarrassing is that these internal deliberations are politically
sentences.zh: 这些内容之所以令人尴尬，是因为这些内部审议在它们所发生的国家里在政治上

sentences.en: sensitive in the countries they're happening in, but they're also central to trying to convince a public in South Korea or Israel that the United States is a trustworthy ally.
sentences.zh: 十分敏感，但它们对于说服韩国或以色列公众相信美国是一个值得信赖的盟友也至关重要。

sentences.en: And people ask the question, well, if that's the case, why are they listening in on our conversations?
sentences.zh: 人们会问这样一个问题，既然如此，他们为什么要监听我们的对话？

sentences.en: And, you know, there's a question of whether or not the leak itself makes it harder for these countries
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这里存在一个问题，即泄密本身是否会使这些国家

sentences.en: to help Ukraine because Ukraine needs the artillery shells and South Korea makes them.
sentences.zh: 更难帮助乌克兰，因为乌克兰需要炮弹，而韩国生产炮弹。

sentences.en: And Ukraine needs anti-missile systems and Israel makes them.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰需要反导系统，而以色列生产它们。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the danger would be that with the publics of those countries, it would be more difficult to do what these governments are doing kind of on the sly.
sentences.zh: 因此，危险在于，在这些国家的公众看来，要去做这些政府在暗地里所做的事情将会变得更加困难。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And when you see it in black and white in a U.S.
sentences.zh: 当你在一份盖有绝密印章的美国

sentences.en: document that's stamped top secret on it, it sort of leaves very little doubt about what's going on.
sentences.zh: 文件中看到这些白纸黑字时，对于正在发生的事情就几乎没什么好怀疑的了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, David, what's the upshot of all these revelations?
sentences.zh: 那么，大卫，所有这些揭秘的最终结果是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, in terms of what the Pentagon is actually worried about in the war in Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就五角大楼对乌克兰战争实际担心的事情而言？

sentences.en: Well, you know, Sabrina, what struck me the most as I was paging through these documents is that our government simply does not know where this war is headed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，萨布丽娜，当我翻阅这些文件时，最让我震惊的是，我们的政府根本不知道这场战争将走向何方。

sentences.en: That, of course, it's worried about a stalemate.
sentences.zh: 当然，它担心陷入僵局。

sentences.en: And General Milley, the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, has said that publicly.
sentences.zh: 参谋长联席会议主席米利将军已经在公开场合说过这一点。

sentences.en: But there's more pessimism, more apprehension that sort of comes off the pages of these documents
sentences.zh: 但从这些文件的字里行间，比官员们在公开场合表现出来的要流露出更多悲观情绪和忧虑

sentences.en: that officials show in public, because, of course, they always want to be supportive of Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 因为，当然，他们总是希望支持泽连斯基。

sentences.en: And in that respect, it's got echoes of the Pentagon Papers, right?
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，这有点像当年的五角大楼文件，对吧？

sentences.en: Because that was contrasting the public optimism.
sentences.zh: 因为那是在对比公众的乐观情绪。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, we're doing great in Vietnam with the public recognition that we were losing the war.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，我们在越南进展顺利，而公众却意识到我们正在输掉这场战争。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But there's something else that I noticed in these documents that really struck me, which is the degree to which the government spends its time thinking about the wild card event,
sentences.zh: 但在这些文件中我还注意到了另一件事，真的让我大吃一惊，那就是政府花在思考那些可能改变一切的突发事件

sentences.en: the black swan, that could change everything.
sentences.zh: 即“黑天鹅”事件上的时间有多少。

sentences.en: For example?
sentences.zh: 比如呢？

sentences.en: Well, there's one document that's full of these what-if scenarios.
sentences.zh: 有一份文件充满了各种“如果……会怎样”的假设情景。

sentences.en: It was written just about a year to the day after the invasion happened.
sentences.zh: 它正好是在入侵发生一周年左右写成的。

sentences.en: So what if Vladimir Putin is killed?
sentences.zh: 如果弗拉基米尔·普京被杀了会怎样？

sentences.en: Could a much more hard-line nationalist leader emerge?
sentences.zh: 会不会出现一个更加强硬的民族主义领导人？

sentences.en: It doesn't answer the question, but it's interesting that they're asking it.
sentences.zh: 它没有回答这个问题，但他们会提出这个问题很有趣。

sentences.en: What if President Zelensky in Ukraine is killed?
sentences.zh: 如果乌克兰的泽连斯基总统被杀了会怎样？

sentences.en: What happens to the leadership?
sentences.zh: 领导层会发生什么？

sentences.en: What happens if the Ukrainians get a hold of a missile that has the reach to fly into Moscow and maybe hit the Kremlin, how would the Russians respond?
sentences.zh: 如果乌克兰人搞到了一种射程足以飞入莫斯科并可能击中克里姆林宫的导弹，俄罗斯人会作何反应？

sentences.en: Would this lead Putin to set off a tactical nuclear weapon, an issue we spent a lot of time last year worried that he might do?
sentences.zh: 这会不会导致普京动用战术核武器？这是我们去年花了很多时间担心他可能会做的事情。

sentences.en: It didn't answer these questions, but the very fact that we're asking them at such high levels in classified sessions
sentences.zh: 它没有回答这些问题，但我们在高级别的机密会议上提出这些问题的这一事实

sentences.en: tells you that the government wants to be ready if the surprising happens here.
sentences.zh: 说明了如果这里发生意外情况，政府希望做好准备。

sentences.en: In other words, tells us how little we actually know about where this thing is going, right?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这告诉我们，对于这件事情的发展方向，我们实际上知之甚少，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, you know, wars, stock markets, hurricanes, hard to predict the path for any of them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，战争、股市、飓风，它们的轨迹都很难预测。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: David, stepping back here for a second, we started this conversation talking about leaks in the context of history, right?
sentences.zh: 大卫，我们退一步来讲，我们开始这场对话时是在历史的背景下谈论泄密事件，对吧？

sentences.en: And you said that this leak was smaller but more current.
sentences.zh: 你说过这次泄密规模较小，但时效性更强。

sentences.en: Did those leaks, the Pentagon Papers, the WikiLeaks,
sentences.zh: 那些泄密事件，比如五角大楼文件、维基解密，

sentences.en: did in a lot of ways change the course of history, change policy and politics in the United States?
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上是否改变了历史进程，改变了美国的政策和政治？

sentences.en: Will this one?
sentences.zh: 这次会吗？

sentences.en: You know, I've been thinking about this a lot, Sabrina, over the past couple of days,
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜，过去几天我一直在思考这个问题，

sentences.en: and I don't think it will.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为它不会。

sentences.en: I think this leak is big news and gives us a sense of the government's doubts, as we've discussed.
sentences.zh: 我认为这次泄密是个大新闻，正如我们所讨论的，它让我们了解了政府的疑虑。

sentences.en: But, you know, the previous leaks that we talked about seem to have an ideological motivation, right?
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我们讨论过的之前的泄密事件似乎有着意识形态的动机，对吧？

sentences.en: Daniel Ellsberg knew that the government was lying to the American people about the progress of the war and was trying to stay in the war despite evidence that it wasn't working.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔·埃尔斯伯格知道政府在战争进展方面对美国人民撒谎，并且在有证据表明战争行不通的情况下仍试图留在战争中。

sentences.en: And he wanted to reveal that.
sentences.zh: 而他想要揭露这一点。

sentences.en: You could think that he's a hero.
sentences.zh: 你可以认为他是英雄。

sentences.en: You can think that he's a traitor.
sentences.zh: 你也可以认为他是叛徒。

sentences.en: But there was an ideological motive there.
sentences.zh: 但那里存在着一种意识形态的动机。

sentences.en: Edward Snowden believed the government was illegally using the NSA's powers to listen in on Americans.
sentences.zh: 爱德华·斯诺登相信政府在非法利用国安局的权力来监听美国人。

sentences.en: There was some evidence of that, but there was also a fair bit of evidence that most of its focus was abroad, which is where the intelligence agencies are supposed to be focusing.
sentences.zh: 有一些证据表明这一点，但也有相当多的证据表明，其大部分重心都在海外，而情报机构本该把重点放在那里。

sentences.en: When you go through these documents, you don't really see, at least I didn't see, an ideological edge.
sentences.zh: 当你仔细阅读这些文件时，你并没有真正看到，至少我没有看到，任何意识形态的锋芒。

sentences.en: And if you believe that, in fact, this was posted first on a gaming website, it's entirely possible that this was more like barroom argument over the Internet than it was ideology.
sentences.zh: 如果你相信，事实上，这最初是发布在一个游戏网站上的，那么这完全有可能更像是互联网上的酒馆争论，而不是出于意识形态。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which may tell you more about this era in America than we really want to know.
sentences.zh: 这可能比我们真正想知道的更能说明美国当前的这个时代。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So my guess is that it will have immediate impact, particularly because the Ukrainians will have to change some of their operational plans,
sentences.zh: 所以我猜它会产生直接影响，特别是因为乌克兰人将不得不改变他们的一些作战计划，

sentences.en: because the Russians will be searching for the ways the United States is listening in on them.
sentences.zh: 因为俄罗斯人将开始搜寻美国监听他们的途径。

sentences.en: But I'm not sure that it will lead to the kind of changes that we remember.
sentences.zh: 但我不敢确定它会导致我们所记忆的那类变革。

sentences.en: However, there doesn't seem to be much division inside the United States government about the validity, the rightness of supporting the Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 然而，美国政府内部在支持乌克兰的合法性和正确性上似乎并没有太大分歧。

sentences.en: The arguments that we discover inside these papers are more about whether the Ukrainians can win,
sentences.zh: 我们在这些文件中发现的争论更多是关于乌克兰能否取胜，

sentences.en: what it will take, what kind of aid they're going to need to get through this next very rough spring and through the year,
sentences.zh: 这需要付出什么代价，他们需要什么样的援助来度过接下来这个非常艰难的春天以及这一年，

sentences.en: and whether in the end there is a negotiated settlement to this war.
sentences.zh: 以及这场战争最终是否会有一个通过谈判达成的解决协议。

sentences.en: Because the question we have to ask about this war, and that sits underneath all of these documents, is tell me how this ends.
sentences.zh: 因为我们必须对这场战争提出、并且所有这些文件背后潜藏的问题是：告诉我这一切将如何结束。

sentences.en: David, thank you.
sentences.zh: 大卫，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, the Washington Post reported that the source of the leaked documents is an American citizen, a gun enthusiast in his 20s who works at a U.S.
sentences.zh: 周三晚上，《华盛顿邮报》报道称，泄密文件的源头是一名美国公民，一个在美军

sentences.en: military base.
sentences.zh: 基地工作的二十多岁枪械爱好者。

sentences.en: The Post cited two people who were members of the online Discord group the leaker was a part of.
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》援引了泄密者所属的一个在线Discord群组的两名成员的话。

sentences.en: The members told the Post that the leaker shared the documents not as a whistleblower who opposed U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些成员告诉《华盛顿邮报》，泄密者分享这些文件并不是作为一个反对美国

sentences.en: policy on the war, but to showcase his access to secret information.
sentences.zh: 战争政策的吹哨人，而是为了炫耀他获取机密信息的能力。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Today, I'm pleased to announce that EPA is proposing the strongest ever federal pollution technology standards for both cars and trucks.
sentences.zh: 今天，我很高兴地宣布，环保署正在为轿车和卡车提出有史以来最严格的联邦污染技术标准。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the Biden administration proposed new climate regulations designed to ensure that by the year 2032, two-thirds of the new cars sold be all-electric.
sentences.zh: 周三，拜登政府提出了新的气候法规，旨在确保到2032年，销售的新车中有三分之二为纯电动汽车。

sentences.en: Together, today's actions will accelerate our ongoing transition to a clean vehicle's future.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，今天的行动将加速我们向清洁汽车未来的持续转型。

sentences.en: The plan is the most ambitious U.S.
sentences.zh: 该计划是迄今为止美国最雄心勃勃的

sentences.en: climate regulation to date and would cause nothing short of a revolution in the auto industry.
sentences.zh: 气候法规，并将在汽车行业引发一场名副其实的革命。

sentences.en: Vehicles that are fully electric accounted for just under 6% of all new cars sold in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 去年全电动汽车仅占美国销售的所有新车的

sentences.en: last year.
sentences.zh: 不到6%。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 而

sentences.en: The message for all the people in Nashville who decided to expel us.
sentences.zh: 给纳什维尔所有决定驱逐我们的人的信息。

sentences.en: You can't expel hope.
sentences.zh: 你们驱逐不了希望。

sentences.en: The second of two Black Democrats expelled from the Tennessee House was reinstated a week after he was removed by the House's Republican majority.
sentences.zh: 田纳西州众议院被驱逐的两名黑人民主党人中的第二位，在被该州众议院多数党共和党人除名一周后恢复了职务。

sentences.en: Local officials in Memphis voted Wednesday to reinstate Justin Pearson.
sentences.zh: 孟菲斯的当地官员周三投票决定恢复贾斯汀·皮尔森的职务。

sentences.en: Earlier this week, the other Democrat, Justin Jones, was also reinstated.
sentences.zh: 本周早些时候，另一位民主党人贾斯汀·琼斯也恢复了职务。

sentences.en: The two had been banished for supporting gun control protesters during House proceedings.
sentences.zh: 这两人此前因在众议院议事期间支持控枪抗议者而被驱逐。

sentences.en: Their expulsion was an act of political retribution, but it ended up propelling them to national fame.
sentences.zh: 他们的被驱逐是一种政治报复行为，但最终却将他们推向了全国闻名的地位。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Diana Nguyen, Will Reed, Mary Wilson, and Luke van der Kluge.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由戴安娜·阮、威尔·里德、玛丽·威尔逊和卢克·范德克卢格制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lisa Chow and M.J.
sentences.zh: 由莉莎·周和M.J.

sentences.en: Davis-Lynn.
sentences.zh: 戴维斯-林恩编辑。

sentences.en: Fact-checked by Susan Lee.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·李进行事实核查。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Marianne Lozano and Dan Powell.
sentences.zh: 包含玛丽安·洛萨诺和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由克里斯·伍德担任音频工程制作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Julian Barnes.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢朱利安·巴恩斯。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《今日秀》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 在本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们将为假期招待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们对光线敏感吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝醉了才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
